user.title: Marantec Garage Door
user.description: Enter the 49-bit code from your remote (as hex, e.g. 1300710DF869F) and choose the RF transmitter. The timing values let Home Assistant model the door's state; leave travel times at 0 to skip the opening/closing phases.

error.invalid_code: The code must be a valid 49-bit hexadecimal value.

abort.no_transmitters: No compatible RF transmitter is set up. Add an ESPHome or Broadlink RF transmitter first.
abort.already_configured: This Marantec code is already configured.
